title: Scenario runner: in template mode, an operation after a one-way state change still goes unmeasured, because the restore writes back through the app's doors
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRH4UCX1tvddXMS7cq

Filing gate: ① defect with a named landing spot. It is the template-mode remainder of #34448, recorded as an out-of-scope finding in that card's dev report (#34448 comment 6931668123, open question 3). Filed by area o2-C of seat `repo:objectstack#2` on the seat's order: priority p2, `domain:devx`.

## What happens

PR #34490 (for #34448) stops writing seeded rows back through the app in scratch and ask modes. Instead, an operation that follows a write runs on a fresh, freshly seeded copy of the same app. Template mode gets no fresh copy. At PR head `dc265d44`, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts:1769-1770` reads:

> No fresh copy here: the app holds the agent's iterate, made live through its doors, which a host booted again would not hold; an earlier write is undone through those doors instead (`restoreSeededRows`).

So in a template-mode half, a card with a one-way state rule (for example `asset_lifecycle`: a decided scrap request never goes back to `submitted`) still has its write-back refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Every later operation reads NOT MEASURED. PR #34490 pins exactly this as the "without a fresh copy" case of its `#34448` describe.

## Why it matters

The eval loses coverage on every template-mode card with a state machine. Its scorecard then shows NOT MEASURED operations, not a verdict on the agent. No customer or user is affected.

## Premise to measure first (the dev does this before any change)

A template-mode copy could be built by installing the **served** metadata of the iterated app (what the agent made live through the app's doors, not the verified build the half started from) into a freshly booted host, then seeding it and creating the personas the way `moveToFreshCopy` does. First measure whether that install reproduces the iterated app:
- the same objects, fields, rules and actions as served;
- the seed loads alike (`seedDifference` empty).

If it does not, report `premise_still_valid: false` with the difference, and do not fall back to any write-back variant.

## Ask

1. If the premise holds: give template mode's iterate Run half a `FreshCopy` that installs the served metadata into a fresh host. Then an operation after a write runs on that copy, as in scratch and ask modes.
2. Tests: the `#34448` describe's "without a fresh copy" case becomes a template-mode case that measures all six `asset_lifecycle` operations. Ablate it (template mode given no copy, so it goes red).
3. Update the `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` bullet "Each operation starts from the seeded rows" so it matches.

Reader: the `repo:objectstack` / devx lane seat, from `pm:queue`, after PR #34490 lands (same file).

Blocked-by: #34448

Dedupe: open and closed issues searched for "template mode restore seeded rows" (182 hits by search term, none on this topic beyond #34448 and #34294), `restoreSeededRows` (2 hits: #34448, #34294 closed), "scenario template one-way rule" (20 hits, none on this topic) and "fresh copy template iterate" (55 hits, none on this topic).
